svg.title: CD4 TCR recognition of DQ presented gluten
svg.desc: Petersen 2014 shows biased, epitope-dependent TCR use. A schematic clone symbol does not imply identical receptors across all patients. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
